table_of_contents.title: The State of Coral Reef Ecosystems of American Samoa

Coastal Development and Runoff Sedimentation is a significant potential threat to the reefs of American Samoa. The islands are very steep and rainfall is often heavy. Currently, steep slopes are almost completely covered by dense native vegetation except in areas cleared for agriculture and quarry operation during prehistoric settlement (Clark and Herdrich, 1993).
